description.value: Copa Cafe is a Hong Kong-style cafe restaurant that has been serving classic Cantonese-Western fusion dishes since 2006. Signature items include baked pork chop on rice, sizzling hot plates, and a coconut-milk curry beef brisket rooted in traditional Hong Kong cafe (cha chaan teng) cooking. The restaurant operates a VIP membership program and rotating seasonal specials, suggesting a loyal local following.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Copa Cafe is an active Hong Kong-style cafe restaurant with a full menu, VIP program, and a January 2025 promotional update, supporting confirmed_open=true. However, the OSM community field lists 'North Vancouver' while the website states the business originated 'in the heart of Coquitlam' and the coordinates (49.28°N, 122.80°W) fall in the Coquitlam/Port Coquitlam area, not North Vancouver — a notable discrepancy. The website makes no mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or any other cycling-relevant amenities, so all such fields must remain null.
